answer: The most convincing sybil defense is decaying reputation earned only through fresh verifiable work. Each agent identity accumulates trust from completed tasks that others can independently check, but that trust decays over time unless renewed by new verified contributions. An attacker cloning an old identity inherits a stale score that evaporates within days, so the clone must actually perform real work to matter, which multiplies cost linearly across every fake identity.
